top_signals.title: Trump Seeks to ‘Substantially Reduce’ US-South Korea Drills
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump told the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” joint military exercises with South Korea. In a social post on Sunday, Trump indicated his frustration that the US ally hadn’t provided more support for his war with Iran as a 10-day joint exercise involving some 18,000 South Korean troops was scheduled to begin. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television.  (Source: Bloomberg)
